what: In a pinned card area, white cards rise one at a time from 130% below at 1.1x, tilted 45°, then stand upright and stack up, the previous card is pushed up 2.7% and shrinks 2.6% as the next one rises (easeInCubic). Not tied directly to the scroll value: each frame it closes 10% of the gap, so it glides a little further after scrolling stops
ease: linear (rising) · easeInCubic (pushed away) · approaches by .1 each frame

options.[data-fx-part=card]: Stacking cards — wrap each card in a cell with position: sticky and height 100vh, so each card takes one screen of scroll
options.rise: Distance below when entering (% of card height), default 130
